scope_notes: Covers the vLLM v0.7.3 PUBLIC config surface a benchmark caller can plausibly touch.

v0.7.3 ships a FLAT vllm/config.py module (single file, ~3490 LOC). The subpackage refactor (vllm.config.*) is a later release; pre-refactor section qualnames in this catalogue are e.g. vllm.config.ModelConfig.
Fields with citation file/line use 1-based line numbers as displayed by Read tool against /tmp/trial_vllm_v0_7_3_venv/src/vllm/.

Field 'type' uses JSON-schema-ish lowercase strings ('string','integer','number','boolean','array','object','null') with 'enum' / 'anyOf' / 'items' when appropriate. 'Any' is encoded as {'type':'object','description':'Any'} to align with the baseline.

engine_envs namespace enumerates every key in vllm.envs.environment_variables (the runtime control surface). This is a CONFIG-LIKE surface but lives outside the dataclass tree; the baseline misses it entirely.

engine_params._note: EngineArgs is the @dataclass that backs the CLI flags; AsyncEngineArgs adds disable_log_requests (line 1399) and is treated as an out-of-scope subclass here.

rope_scaling.deprecation_note: DeprecationWarning emitted in ModelConfig.__init__: use --hf-overrides instead

quantization.constraint: must be in QUANTIZATION_METHODS or match hf_config quant_method

tokenizer_pool_extra_config.constraint: must be a dict (post-parsing) or null

speculative_draft_tensor_parallel_size.constraint: must be 1 or equal to target tensor_parallel_size

sampling_params._note: SamplingParams is a msgspec.Struct (NOT a dataclass). Validation lives in __post_init__ (line 287) and _verify_args (line 352).

temperature.normalisation: if 0 < temperature < 1e-2 the value is clamped up to 1e-2 with a warning (line 303-307); if temperature < _SAMPLING_EPS (1e-5) sampling becomes greedy and top_p/top_k/min_p are reset

stop.normalisation: None->[], str->[str]; entries must be non-empty; requires detokenize=True

min_tokens.constraint: must be >= 0 and <= max_tokens (when max_tokens set)

logits_processors.items_description: Optional[Any] (typed as Optional[List[LogitsProcessor]] in from_optional; msgspec cannot encode the union, so the struct field is Any)

output_text_buffer_length.normalisation: set in __post_init__: max(len(s) for s in stop)-1 when stop non-empty and include_stop_str_in_output is False

_all_stop_token_ids.normalisation: set in __post_init__ from stop_token_ids; engine adds eos_token_id later

logit_bias.normalisation: from_optional clamps each bias to [-100, 100] per OpenAI spec

beam_search_params._note: Mode-exclusive with SamplingParams (the caller picks one). Two REQUIRED fields (beam_width, max_tokens) - msgspec rejects construction without them. The baseline omits this struct entirely.

pooling_params._note: Placeholder in v0.7.3 (the source self-describes as 'currently a placeholder'). Out of scope for LLEM's text-generation focus but enumerated for completeness.

guided_decoding_params._note: Sub-struct of SamplingParams.guided_decoding. Five constraint-mode fields are mutually exclusive (validator at line 67-76). The baseline omits this struct entirely.

subconfigs._note: v0.7.3 keeps the entire config tree in a flat vllm.config module (~3490 LOC). The subpackage refactor (vllm.config.*) is post-0.10.x. EngineArgs fans these out, but several fields are subconfig-only (no EngineArgs surface) and are listed here only.

ModelConfig._note: NOT a dataclass - plain class with imperative __init__. Subconfig-only fields below have no EngineArgs counterpart but are reachable via direct ModelConfig(...) usage.

spec_target_max_model_len.purpose: used internally for speculative draft models to clamp max_model_len

TokenizerPoolConfig._note: @dataclass; all three fields are required. Created indirectly via TokenizerPoolConfig.create_config from tokenizer_pool_size/_type/_extra_config EngineArgs.

load_format.normalisation: str is lower()ed and parsed via LoadFormat(...)

distributed_executor_backend.constraint: must be 'ray', 'mp', 'uni', 'external_launcher', None, or an ExecutorBase subclass

SchedulerConfig._note: @dataclass. Fields exposed via EngineArgs use the same names; subconfig-only fields below.

max_num_batched_tokens.normalisation: if None: 2048 (chunked) / max(max_model_len,2048) (non-chunked); pooling bumps to 32768; multimodal bumps to 5120

max_num_seqs.note: EngineArgs.max_num_seqs has default None but SchedulerConfig default is 128

max_num_partial_prefills.constraint: >=1; and if >1 chunked_prefill must be enabled

long_prefill_token_threshold.normalisation: if 0 and max_num_partial_prefills>1: set to int(max_model_len*0.04)

max_num_encoder_input_tokens.purpose: V1 multimodal encoder budget; initialised to max_num_batched_tokens

encoder_cache_size.purpose: V1 encoder cache; initialised to max_num_batched_tokens

multi_step_stream_outputs.note: SchedulerConfig default is False; EngineArgs default is True

DeviceConfig._note: Plain class with __init__(device:str='auto'). The two visible attributes are device and device_type, both derived from the input.

device.computed: torch.device(device_type) or None for tpu or cpu for neuron/openvino

SpeculativeConfig._note: Plain class with imperative __init__. Most fields are derived; EngineArgs flag set already enumerated above. Listed here are the constructor params on SpeculativeConfig.__init__ (line 2030).

LoRAConfig._note: @dataclass. Most fields mirror EngineArgs. bias_enabled is subconfig-only.

lora_dtype.normalisation: if None or 'auto' or str: resolved against torch

prompt_adapter_dtype.normalisation: if None or 'auto' or str: resolved against torch

MultiModalConfig._note: @dataclass. Single field in v0.7.3 - the class is intentionally stub-like (TODO comment in source).

KVTransferConfig._note: Pydantic BaseModel (NOT dataclass). Validators in model_post_init at line 2735.

kv_role.constraint: must be one of {kv_producer, kv_consumer, kv_both} when set; must be set when kv_connector is set

CompilationConfig._note: Pydantic BaseModel. PrivateAttr fields are computed-not-input.

backend.note: empty string defaults to 'eager' at init_backend

custom_ops.constraint: can specify at most one of 'all' or 'none'

engine_envs._note: Every key in vllm.envs.environment_variables. Each entry is a lambda evaluated lazily on attribute access (envs.VLLM_FOO triggers re-read of os.environ). Read at runtime by config code and platform / backend selection. This is the RUNTIME control surface AND is NOT in baseline coverage.
engine_envs._access_pattern: import vllm.envs as envs; envs.VLLM_USE_V1 (triggers __getattr__ -> environment_variables[name]())

VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE.behaviour: Target device for vLLM build/runtime (cuda, rocm, neuron, cpu, openvino)

MAX_JOBS.behaviour: Maximum parallel compilation jobs; defaults to CPU count

NVCC_THREADS.behaviour: Threads per nvcc invocation; if set, MAX_JOBS is reduced

VLLM_USE_PRECOMPILED.behaviour: Use precompiled binaries instead of building locally

CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE.behaviour: CMake build type for native extensions

VLLM_CONFIG_ROOT.behaviour: Where vLLM looks for and installs configs

VLLM_CACHE_ROOT.behaviour: Cache root for downloaded assets and compiled artefacts

VLLM_HOST_IP.behaviour: IP address to use in distributed inference setups

VLLM_PORT.behaviour: First port in the comm-port sequence for multi-process / multi-node

VLLM_RPC_BASE_PATH.behaviour: Base path for IPC sockets between frontend and engine processes

VLLM_USE_MODELSCOPE.behaviour: Load models from ModelScope instead of HF Hub

CUDA_HOME.behaviour: Path to CUDA toolkit install (used at build / NCCL discovery)

VLLM_NCCL_SO_PATH.behaviour: Explicit path to NCCL shared lib (works around PyTorch nccl>=2.19 bug)

LD_LIBRARY_PATH.behaviour: Standard ld search path; consulted as NCCL fallback when VLLM_NCCL_SO_PATH unset

VLLM_USE_TRITON_FLASH_ATTN.behaviour: Whether to use Triton implementation of flash attention (gated by hw)

VLLM_FLASH_ATTN_VERSION.behaviour: Force flash-attention version 2 or 3 when using flash-attention backend

VLLM_TEST_DYNAMO_FULLGRAPH_CAPTURE.behaviour: Internal: enable Dynamo fullgraph capture for tests

LOCAL_RANK.behaviour: Local rank of the process in distributed setting (selects GPU device)

VLLM_ENGINE_ITERATION_TIMEOUT_S.behaviour: Per-iteration engine watchdog timeout in seconds

VLLM_API_KEY.behaviour: Bearer token enforced by the OpenAI-compatible API server

S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.behaviour: AWS credentials for tensorizer S3 model load

S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.behaviour: AWS credentials for tensorizer S3 model load

VLLM_USAGE_STATS_SERVER.behaviour: Upload endpoint for opt-in usage telemetry

VLLM_USAGE_SOURCE.behaviour: Label attached to usage stats uploads

VLLM_CONFIGURE_LOGGING.behaviour: 0 = don't configure logging; 1 = use default or VLLM_LOGGING_CONFIG_PATH

VLLM_LOGGING_CONFIG_PATH.behaviour: Path to JSON dictConfig for Python logging

VLLM_LOGGING_PREFIX.behaviour: Prefix prepended to every log message

VLLM_LOGITS_PROCESSOR_THREADS.behaviour: Thread pool size for logits processors; useful for processors that launch CUDA kernels or do GIL-released CPU work

VLLM_TRACE_FUNCTION.behaviour: 1 = trace every Python function call (debugging aid)

VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND.behaviour: Force the attention backend (otherwise auto-selected by platform)

VLLM_FLASHINFER_FORCE_TENSOR_CORES.behaviour: Force flashinfer to use tensor cores (overrides arch heuristic)

VLLM_CPU_KVCACHE_SPACE.behaviour: CPU backend: KV cache space in GiB (default 4 in docs, 0 in code if unset)

VLLM_CPU_OMP_THREADS_BIND.behaviour: CPU backend: OpenMP thread-binding spec (e.g. '0-31', '0,1,2', '0-31,33' separated by '|' for ranks)
VLLM_CPU_OMP_THREADS_BIND.note: TYPE_CHECKING stub uses default '' but the lambda default is 'all'

VLLM_OPENVINO_KVCACHE_SPACE.behaviour: OpenVINO KV cache space in GiB

VLLM_OPENVINO_CPU_KV_CACHE_PRECISION.behaviour: OpenVINO KV cache precision; u8 enables KV-cache compression

VLLM_OPENVINO_ENABLE_QUANTIZED_WEIGHTS.behaviour: OpenVINO: compress weights via HF Optimum export

VLLM_USE_RAY_SPMD_WORKER.behaviour: Run workers as separate processes from the engine (Ray SPMD)

VLLM_USE_RAY_COMPILED_DAG.behaviour: Use Ray's compiled DAG API for reduced control-plane overhead

VLLM_USE_RAY_COMPILED_DAG_NCCL_CHANNEL.behaviour: Use NCCL channel for Ray compiled DAG (ignored if VLLM_USE_RAY_COMPILED_DAG=0)

VLLM_USE_RAY_COMPILED_DAG_OVERLAP_COMM.behaviour: Experimental GPU comm overlap in Ray compiled DAG

VLLM_ASSETS_CACHE.behaviour: Cache dir for downloaded multimodal assets

VLLM_IMAGE_FETCH_TIMEOUT.behaviour: Seconds before image fetch times out (multimodal)

VLLM_VIDEO_FETCH_TIMEOUT.behaviour: Seconds before video fetch times out (multimodal)

VLLM_AUDIO_FETCH_TIMEOUT.behaviour: Seconds before audio fetch times out (multimodal)

VLLM_MM_INPUT_CACHE_SIZE.behaviour: Number of multimodal items kept in the input cache

VLLM_FUSED_MOE_CHUNK_SIZE.behaviour: Chunk size for fused-MoE kernels (TYPE_CHECKING stub claims 64*1024 = 65536; lambda default differs at line 430)
VLLM_FUSED_MOE_CHUNK_SIZE.discrepancy_note: stub vs lambda default disagree; the lambda value (32768) is the one taken at runtime

VLLM_KEEP_ALIVE_ON_ENGINE_DEATH.behaviour: Keep API server alive after AsyncLLMEngine errors

VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN.behaviour: Allow user max_model_len > model config.json length

VLLM_TEST_FORCE_FP8_MARLIN.behaviour: Force FP8 Marlin kernels even if hw supports FP8 compute (test only)

VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT.behaviour: ZMQ client timeout for simple backend ops

VLLM_PLUGINS.behaviour: Comma-separated plugin name allowlist; null = all plugins; empty string = no plugins

VLLM_TORCH_PROFILER_DIR.behaviour: If set, enables torch profiler; must be an absolute path

VLLM_USE_TRITON_AWQ.behaviour: Use Triton implementations of AWQ quantization kernels

VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING.behaviour: Allow loading/unloading LoRA adapters at runtime via API

VLLM_SKIP_P2P_CHECK.behaviour: Trust driver p2p capability report (skip vllm's own probe)

VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS.behaviour: Comma-separated list of disabled kernel names (currently only MPLinearKernel selection: MacheteLinearKernel, MarlinLinearKernel, ExllamaLinearKernel)

VLLM_USE_V1.behaviour: Switch to the V1 engine code path (changes compilation defaults, scheduling, output processing)

K_SCALE_CONSTANT.behaviour: Divisor for dynamic K scale calc in FP8 KV cache

V_SCALE_CONSTANT.behaviour: Divisor for dynamic V scale calc in FP8 KV cache

VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING.behaviour: Enable multiprocessing in V1 LLM code path

VLLM_LOG_BATCHSIZE_INTERVAL.behaviour: Seconds between batchsize log prints (-1 disables)

VLLM_V1_OUTPUT_PROC_CHUNK_SIZE.behaviour: Max requests processed per asyncio task in V1 AsyncLLM output handling

VLLM_MLA_PERFORM_MATRIX_ABSORPTION.behaviour: MLA: absorb W_UK into W_Q/W_UK and W_UV into W_O (reduces FLOPs at cost of memory)

VLLM_MLA_DISABLE_REQUANTIZATION.behaviour: MLA+fp8: skip requantisation back to fp8 after fp32 matrix-absorption

VLLM_RAY_PER_WORKER_GPUS.behaviour: Per-worker GPU fraction for Ray; fractional values allow GPU co-location

VLLM_RAY_BUNDLE_INDICES.behaviour: Comma-separated Ray bundle indices per worker (e.g. '0,1,2,3')

VLLM_CUDA_MEM_ALIGN_KV_CACHE.behaviour: On Nvidia GPU align KV-cache entries to 256 bytes (currently only affects MLA)
VLLM_CUDA_MEM_ALIGN_KV_CACHE.note: TYPE_CHECKING stub spells this VLLM_MLA_CUDA_MEM_ALIGN_KV_CACHE; the lambda key is VLLM_CUDA_MEM_ALIGN_KV_CACHE - the lambda key is authoritative

VLLM_CUDART_SO_PATH.behaviour: Explicit path to libcudart.so when find_loaded_library fails

VLLM_USE_HPU_CONTIGUOUS_CACHE_FETCH.behaviour: HPU: contiguous cache fetch (Gaudi3) - actually reads env var VLLM_CONTIGUOUS_PA, not VLLM_USE_HPU_CONTIGUOUS_CACHE_FETCH
VLLM_USE_HPU_CONTIGUOUS_CACHE_FETCH.discrepancy_note: key (attribute) and env-var name DIFFER: attr is VLLM_USE_HPU_CONTIGUOUS_CACHE_FETCH but the lambda reads os.environ['VLLM_CONTIGUOUS_PA']
